note: 0.6 (Lateralus, 9 November 2026: 'add an F-22 Target Dummy to the game, with 0 speed, 1000 hitpoints, and 1000 flares ... also add a MiG-29K target dummy'). Test targets for missile tests: full copies of the F-22 Raptor (297) and MiG-29K (311) in the parent's decks, with 1000 HP, 1000 flares and no forward speed. Plane speed comes from the fly preset (F-22: min 175, max 250, afterburner 350); the dummies get their own preset with every speed at 1 (0 risks a divide by zero in the flight code), no afterburner, and 3600 s loiter time so they stay over the map. Card speed 0. ECM, flare strength and timing, weapons and costs are the parent's. Not yet run in a game.
